established_findings.text: On 14 March, Building 2 lost utility power at 02:14 local time, and the outage lasted 4 hours 20 minutes, affecting 312 customers.
Building 1 was not affected by the incident.
The outage was caused by a transformer failure at Substation 7, as reported by the utility provider.
The root cause of the incident remains under investigation.

unresolved_conflicts.summary: UPS duration reported as 15 minutes (F2) versus 9 minutes (F14).
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Clarification of the actual UPS runtime from system logs.

unresolved_conflicts.summary: Service restoration time reported as 06:34 (F3) versus 08:05 (F18).
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Verification of the exact time when normal service was confirmed.

unresolved_conflicts.summary: Failover approval attributed to Priya Raman (F6) versus Daniel Okafor (F15).
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Confirmation of the authorized personnel from official approval records.

unresolved_conflicts.summary: Generator B fuel capacity reported as 11 hours (F21) versus 3 hours at 20% (F27).
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Inspection of the fuel inventory records and tank level measurements.

root_cause_statement: The root cause is still under investigation.
conclusion: The Larkspur Data Center’s Building 2 experienced a 4‑hour 20‑minute outage on 14 March due to a transformer failure at Substation 7, impacting 312 customers while Building 1 remained unaffected. The incident’s root cause remains under investigation, and several key details—such as UPS runtime, service restoration time, failover approval, and generator fuel capacity—are unresolved and require further evidence.
